contracts.assessment: Prefix range is checked before mask arithmetic, including valid 8-bit mask. checked_shl on unit scale bounds the shift; checked_mul rejects loss of nonzero high bits; checked_add rejects accumulated overflow. After the bounded shift succeeds, shift += 7 cannot overflow its u32 type before the next iteration rejects an excessive shift. Cursor increments occur only after successful slice element access and fit the actual slice. No release-mode wrapping acceptance remains.

An actual remaining slice is obtained after decoding. length <= remaining.len proves cursor + length <= block.len before cursor advancement, rejecting the demonstrated near-usize::MAX string length without unchecked sum.

Nonempty remaining input requires all nine header bytes and then its full 24-bit declared payload. Safe subslices advance only after successful bounds checks. A priority flag requires at least five bytes. Complete plain/priority blocks retain their literal order. Padded or multi-frame HEADERS remain outside this private decoder contract.
The actual Huffman attribute permits only none/true/false, with a recoverable error for unknown input. Other parse, size-update, field and request ordering semantics remain byte-identical.

Even ASCII hexadecimal validation rejects signed +1 and non-ASCII before conversion. Empty and mixed-case valid inputs remain accepted. Even length and ASCII ensure two-byte str ranges are safe; decoded non-UTF8 strings remain fallible at actual String::from_utf8 callers. Unicode was already safely rejected by the old str::get and is not a new panic fix.
